diagnosis: In get_queryset(), the view checks if org_id is present in query_params and queries OrganizationAuditLog solely by that organization_id without validating that request.user belongs to that organization. Any authenticated user can paginate through any organization's security audit logs.
exploit_request:
GET /api/audit-logs/?org_id=902 HTTP/1.1
Host: enterprise.saas.example
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
